prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Choose Your Desktop Companion", "Select one of our instantly ready companions to move right into your desktop workflow."]
1: ["Already adopted a pet? Sign in with your original account to restore your existing desktop pet instantly."]
2: ["Setting Up Desktop Environment...", "Configuring desktop overlay permissions and warming up pet animations.", "Checking desktop window permissions"]
3: ["Meet Your Desktop Companion!", "Your pet is now active. Click below to spawn them onto your screen.", "Release Pet to Desktop"]
4: ["How Would You Like to Start?"]
5: []
6: ["System Tray Quick Controls", "Your pet lives in your system tray! Right-click the icon anytime to pause, feed, hide, or interact.", "Got It!"]
7: ["Official Adoption Certificate", "Give your desktop companion a custom name to finalize their adoption parameters.", "Seal Certificate & Continue"]
8: ["Taking longer than usual? Click retry or check your internet connection.", "Retry Connection"]
9: ["Find Your Ideal Desktop Match", "Answer 2 quick questions so we can suggest the perfect pet companion path for your workflow."]
